India's Wholesale Inflation Eases to 9.78% in July

India's wholesale price inflation decreased to 9.78% in July, a marginal easing from previous levels. This moderation was primarily driven by a significant drop in the fuel and power segment, with fuel prices cooling. Despite the overall decrease, food items continued to experience price increases during the same month.
